{{Top|leg}}
'''Landing Platform Thyss''' was a landing platform in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] landed the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] there, where it stayed for several weeks in the care of his cousins [[Jowdrrl]] and [[Dryanta]]. Gawkers from across the planet came to see the legendary [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and have [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of themselves taken next to it.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'' misspells "Thyss" as "Thiss."
